query:
-- 查詢最近 90 天內的最早價格
(SELECT 
  'Oldest in 90 days' as label,
  ph.price,
  ph.soldAt,
  DATEDIFF(NOW(), ph.soldAt) as daysAgo
FROM priceHistory ph
JOIN cards c ON ph.cardId = c.id
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Japanese National Team%'
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
  AND ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
ORDER BY ph.soldAt ASC
LIMIT 1)

UNION ALL

(SELECT 
  'Newest in 90 days' as label,
  ph.price,
  ph.soldAt,
  DATEDIFF(NOW(), ph.soldAt) as daysAgo
FROM priceHistory ph
JOIN cards c ON ph.cardId = c.id
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Japanese National Team%'
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
  AND ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
ORDER BY ph.soldAt DESC
LIMIT 1);
